bug_info.bug_desc: The read-data return multiplexers in csrng_reg_top.sv and entropy_src_reg_top.sv each use a unique case with a default branch that drives reg_rdata_next to all ones. The same combinational blocks already initialize reg_rdata_next to zero before the case, so the default branch is redundant. For accesses where no addr_hit bit is asserted (unmapped or reserved address space), the default branch returns 0xFFFFFFFF instead of the required zero, and the presence of a catch-all default in a unique case causes synthesis/formality tools to flag potential case-item overlap.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the default branch from the unique case read-data mux in both csrng_reg_top.sv and entropy_src_reg_top.sv. Rely on the existing reg_rdata_next = '0 initialization at the start of the always_comb block to supply the default read value for unmapped or reserved addresses.
